title: Larger Ender Chest
description: Makes Ender Chests use 54 inventory slots instead of 27.
body:
Bigger Ender Chest expands Ender Chests from 27 slots to 54 slots, giving players the storage size of a double chest while keeping the vanilla Ender Chest behavior.

This is useful for servers and modpacks that need more personal storage without adding complicated new blocks or mechanics.

Features:

  • Expands Ender Chest storage to 54 slots

Perfect for survival servers, large modpacks, or players who constantly run out of Ender Chest space.
